#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class MathUtility {
public:
    static int add(int a, int b, int MOD) {
        int res = a + b;
        if (res >= MOD) {
            res -= MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

class DNekoAndAkisPrank {
private:
    static const int MOD = 1000000007;

    int getVal(const vector<vector<vector<int>>> &dp, int i, int j, bool selectStart, bool selectEnd) {
        int ret = 0;
        if (i - j >= 2) {
            if (selectStart) {
                ret = MathUtility::add(ret, dp[i - 1][j + 1][1], MOD);
                ret = MathUtility::add(ret, 1, MOD);
            } else {
                ret = MathUtility::add(ret, dp[i - 1][j + 1][0], MOD);
            }
        }
        if (j > 0) {
            if (selectEnd) {
                ret = MathUtility::add(ret, dp[i - 1][j - 1][1], MOD);
                ret = MathUtility::add(ret, 1, MOD);
            } else {
                ret = MathUtility::add(ret, dp[i - 1][j - 1][0], MOD);
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

public:
    int solve(int n) {
        int N = 2 * n;
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(N + 1, vector<vector<int>>(N + 1, vector<int>(2, 0)));
        // Initialization
        dp[0][0][0] = 0;
        dp[0][0][1] = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= 1; k++) {
                    if (k == 1) {
                        if (i - j >= 2) {
                            dp[i][j][k] = MathUtility::add(dp[i][j][k], dp[i - 1][j + 1][0], MOD);
                        }
                        if (j > 0) {
                            dp[i][j][k] = MathUtility::add(dp[i][j][k], dp[i - 1][j - 1][0], MOD);
                        }
                    } else {
                        int val0 = getVal(dp, i, j, false, false);
                        int val1 = getVal(dp, i, j, false, true);
                        int val2 = getVal(dp, i, j, true, false);
                        dp[i][j][0] = max({val0, val1, val2});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[N][0][0];
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    DNekoAndAkisPrank solver;
    cout << solver.solve(n) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
